record.excerpt: In this paper we propose lifted Markov Chains (MCs) as a new paradigm for deriving patrol strategies for mobile agents on an environment represented as a graph. record.title: iPrefBench: A User-Centric Benchmark for Personalized Mobile Use Agents
record.excerpt: An agent that truly knows and acts on behalf of its user has been a long-standing promise of AI assistants. Computer-use agents bring this promise within reach by capably executing fully specified tasks across apps. However, real-world user requests are often underspecified. To act correctly for the particular user, an agent must infer some missing information from the user's activity history and ask for other information that only the user can provide, without making unsupported assumptions or burdening the user with unnecessary questions. record.excerpt: Semantic communication is emerging as a pivotal paradigm to overcome wireless resource scarcity in 6G networks. record.title: Real-Time Conveyor Belt Defect Detection via Edge TPU-Accelerated YOLOv11 on Raspberry Pi 5
record.excerpt: Conveyor belts are vital arteries in continuous bulk material handling, particularly in heavy process industries such as cement manufacturing. Undetected structural anomalies (longitudinal tears, holes, degraded patch repairs, and impact punctures) cause catastrophic belt snapping, costly downtime, and severe safety hazards. While deep learning offers high accuracy, existing models rely on power-hungry workstation GPUs, hindering practical deployment at remote industrial edge points.
